reason: A named independent lab with the batch report on the page and a QR code is exactly what I look for, and bisglycinate with a stated 200 mg dose and no oxide is what I would pick anyway. At $24.99 for the first box and with a money-back guarantee, I would try one box and see.
objection: I would open the report first. If the lab is not a real one I can look up, or the report is a generic PDF that does not match my batch number, it is just marketing and I am out.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch was missing, unreadable, or did not show the actual magnesium amount per capsule, I would not buy.
